title: Feed a manikin a spoonful of soup with one hand while the other holds the bowl under its chin
instruction: Hold the soup bowl under the manikin's chin with one hand, and with the other bring the spoon to its mouth and tip the spoonful in, spilling none.
context: Helping someone eat is daily work for carers in hospitals and care homes. The carer holds the bowl under the person's chin to catch drips while the other hand brings the spoon to the mouth and tips the food in.
setup: A table in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them. (1) A fixed care-training manikin of PVC vinyl, head and shoulders, on the centre line: shoulders 10 x 22 cm and 7 cm tall centred 47 cm forward, and a blocky head 11 cm wide whose face is 40.5 cm forward and top 21.5 cm above the table. Its mouth is open, 4.5 cm wide and 3 cm tall, its lower lip 11.4 cm above the table; behind the lip the mouth's floor drops 1.5 cm, 5 cm deep. (2) A loose steel feeding spoon, 30 g: a bowl 4 x 2.2 cm with 4 mm rims and a handle 14 cm long, lying level on a fixed beech-wood rest 6 cm above the table, its bowl 33 cm forward and 13 cm right, its handle toward the arms; in its bowl, four soup beads 9 mm across (glass beads standing in for soup). (3) A loose white porcelain soup bowl, 150 g, 11 cm across and 4 cm tall with a stick handle 12 cm long reaching left from its rim, 30 cm forward and 12 cm left. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial. Swallowed: a bead in the pit behind the manikin's lower lip. Spilt: a bead lower than 4.5 cm above the table and not in the bowl. Under the chin: the bowl's middle within 7 cm (seen from above) of a point 3 cm in front of the chin, its rim below the lower lip and its underside at least 2 cm off the table, when the first bead is swallowed. 1.0: at least 3 of the 4 beads swallowed, none spilt, with the bowl under the chin; 0.5: at least 3 swallowed and at most 1 spilt; 0.25: at least 1 swallowed; else 0.0. The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held with the beads still for 1 s.
reset_notes: Tip the soup beads out of the manikin's mouth (and the bowl) back into the spoon, lay the spoon level on its rest and stand the bowl where it was.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz control). Simplified: the soup is four rigid beads 9 mm across. The manikin is rigid and fixed, its open mouth a box-shaped cavity with a pit behind the lower lip that keeps what is tipped in (no jaw, no swallowing). The spoon and the bowl are rigid. Cameras 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
